help_back_enabled: Turn this on to give visitors a button that takes them back to the page they were viewing before.
help_back_placement: Choose whether the back button floats separately on the page or appears as one of the buttons in the navigation bar.
help_background: Choose the background colour of the navigation bar when the store uses this colour mode.
help_cart_tab: Show the cart item count on this button. Only one button can do this.
help_config: Set up the menu buttons visitors see in your store, choose where each button appears, and adjust how the navigation bar looks. Each button can open a store page or a local URL such as /home. These settings do not change your store pages or products.
help_content: Choose the colour used for the navigation button text and icons in this colour mode.
help_glass_animate: Turn this on to make changes to the navigation appearance transition smoothly instead of changing instantly.
help_glass_color_scheme: Choose whether the glass bar follows the device appearance automatically or always uses light or dark colours.
help_glass_duration: Choose how long the appearance transition takes, in seconds. Enter 0 to change instantly without an animation.
help_glass_enabled: Turn this on to use the translucent Liquid Glass appearance on iOS 26 or later. Other devices show the regular appearance.
help_glass_interactive: Turn this on to let the glass appearance respond to touch and movement on devices that support this effect.
help_glass_opacity: Set how strongly the tint colour appears. Enter a value from 0 to 1: 0 adds no tint, and 1 applies the strongest tint.
help_glass_style: Regular keeps the usual glass, Clear makes it more transparent, and None turns the effect off.
help_glass_tint: Choose a colour tint to blend into the glass bar. This changes the glass colour without changing your store content.
help_icon_catalog: Icon displayed beside this menu button.
help_shown_on_pages: Choose where this button appears. No selected pages means it stays hidden.
help_status: Turn this on to display the AppNuno navigation to store visitors. Turn it off to hide the navigation; your saved settings will remain unchanged.
help_tab_destination: Choose a store page, or enter a full address or a path such as /home with Custom URL.
help_tab_id: Unique internal name. Use letters, numbers, hyphens, or underscores.
help_tab_labels: Button text shown to visitors in each language.
help_tab_visibility: Hide this button without deleting it.
